title: vibe-iterate per-project config
description: Generated by Ptolemy at first run from codebase + README inference; user-editable. Lives at .vibe-iterate/config.json in the host project.

category.description: One-line description of the app's product category, used by Competitive mode and Product Hunt scans

competitors.description: User-curated list of competitor URLs (changelogs, what's-new pages, GH releases). Used by Competitive mode.

ecosystem.description: Registry to query for this pin. Omitted = npm (back-compat: bootstrap only writes this field for non-npm pins, so JS-project configs stay byte-compatible with pre-1.3.0 validators).

framework_pins.description: Framework/SDK pins as scanned from the project manifest (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, *.csproj). Used by scheduled radar refresh and :scan-releases.

last_inferred_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last codebase+README inference run
